metadata.description: The elevenlabs-cli tool and the Claude Code plugin that drives it. Installing the plugin from this marketplace also brings the CLI source, so one clone provides both.

plugins.name: elevenlabs
plugins.description: Generate audio with ElevenLabs from Claude Code: speech in any language, multi-speaker dialogue, guided pieces with exact pauses, sound effects, noise beds, transcription, and a measured voice-casting workflow. Drives the elevenlabs-cli command, which this repository provides.
